outlooks.summary: SCATTERED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED ESPECIALLY ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. OTHER ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF WIND DAMAGE MAY OCCUR FROM THE MID-SOUTH TO THE OHIO VALLEY AND CAROLINAS.

sections.title: THERE IS AN ENH RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PARTS OF WESTERN KS
sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PORTIONS OF THE HIGH PLAINS... ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS STRETCHING FROM THE NORTHERN ROCKIES AND CENTRAL PLAINS...INTO THE CAROLINAS AND SOUTHEAST STATES...

sections.title: HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: A LARGE CLUSTER OF CONVECTION IS ONGOING THIS MORNING OVER PARTS OF NEB AND NORTHERN KS. THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ALONG THE SOUTHWEST FLANK OF THIS ACTIVITY IS LIKELY TO PLAY A ROLE IN DEVELOPMENT OF SEVERE STORMS THIS AFTERNOON OVER PARTS OF NORTHWEST KS/NORTHEAST CO. FORECAST SOUNDINGS IN THIS AREA SHOW STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND FAVORABLE DEEP LAYER SHEAR FOR SUPERCELL STORM STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. MOST MODEL SOLUTIONS SHOW CONSISTENCY IN UPSCALE ORGANIZATION OF THE ACTIVITY BY LATE AFTERNOON/EVENING OVER WESTERN KS...WITH BOWING STRUCTURES EXPECTED. THE POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR A MORE WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WIND EVENT...SO HAVE ADDED AN ENHANCED RISK AREA. UNCERTAINTY REMAINS HOW FAR SOUTH THE SEVERE THREAT WILL PERSIST OVERNIGHT...SINCE IT WILL BE DRIVEN MORE BY MESOSCALE ORGANIZATION THAN LARGE SCALE FEATURES.

sections.title: CAROLINAS
sections.text: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS MOSTLY CLEAR SKIES OVER MUCH OF NC/SC WHERE DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE MID 70S. THIS WILL YIELD AFTERNOON MAX MLCAPE VALUES OVER 2500 J/KG. SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP OVER THIS AREA...WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR LOCALLY INTENSE DOWNBURSTS IN THE STRONGER CELLS. MID LEVEL STEERING FLOW OF ONLY AROUND 20 KNOTS AND SLACK LOW LEVEL WINDS SUGGEST THAT CONVECTIVE ORGANIZATION WILL BE QUITE LIMITED TODAY...SO WILL MAINTAIN ONLY A MARGINAL RISK CATEGORY.

sections.title: MT
sections.text: A RATHER STRONG UPPER LOW IS DIGGING SOUTHEASTWARD INTO WA/ID TODAY...WITH MID LEVEL HEIGHT FALLS SPREADING INTO MT. ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO FORM THIS AFTERNOON OVER THE MOUNTAINS OF WESTERN MT...AND OVER SOUTHERN MT WHERE AN AXIS OF SLIGHTLY GREATER INSTABILITY WILL BE PRESENT. THERE IS SOME CONCERN FOR A MORE ORGANIZED SEVERE THREAT OVER SOUTHERN MT...AND THOUGHT WAS GIVEN TO ADDING A SLIGHT RISK FOR THIS AREA. HOWEVER...LIMITED LOW LEVEL MOISTURE AND LACK OF STRONG INSTABILITY IS CURRENTLY EXPECTED TO KEEP THE OVERALL SEVERE RISK LOW. THIS WILL BE RE-EVALUATED AT 20Z. ..HART/COOK.. 07/15/2016

outlooks.summary: DAMAGING WIND GUSTS ARE FORECAST TO ACCOMPANY THUNDERSTORMS SPREADING ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE TEXAS PANHANDLE AND SOUTH PLAINS...WESTERN OKLAHOMA...AND VICINITY INTO THE EARLY OVERNIGHT HOURS.

sections.title: THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS PARTS OF CNTRL/ERN MT
sections.text: ...SUMMARY... DAMAGING WIND GUSTS ARE FORECAST TO ACCOMPANY THUNDERSTORMS SPREADING ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE TEXAS PANHANDLE AND SOUTH PLAINS...WESTERN OKLAHOMA...AND VICINITY INTO THE EARLY OVERNIGHT HOURS.

sections.title: PORTIONS OF OK...SWRN KS...W/N TX...NRN LA
sections.text: MERGING TSTM CLUSTERS FROM SWRN KS INTO E-CNTRL NM ARE SUPPORTING UPSCALE CONVECTIVE GROWTH WITHIN THIS CORRIDOR. A FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS IS FORECAST TO EVOLVE FROM THIS ACTIVITY ACROSS PORTIONS OF WRN OK AND THE TX PANHANDLE/S PLAINS THIS EVENING AND ADVANCE SEWD/SSEWD. THIS WILL OCCUR AS STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL SLYS ENHANCE CONVECTIVE INFLOW...WHILE THE LARGE DCAPE /INDICATED TO BE AROUND 1660 J PER KG BY THE 00Z AMA RAOB/ SUPPORTS STRONG COLD-POOL CONSOLIDATION. DMGG WIND GUSTS WILL LIKELY ACCOMPANY THIS ACTIVITY INTO THE EARLY OVERNIGHT HOURS...BEFORE NOCTURNAL GAINS IN MLCINH SUPPORT A DECREASE IN CONVECTIVE INTENSITY AS TSTMS SPREAD ACROSS PARTS OF THE SERN TX S PLAINS/LOW ROLLING PLAINS. THE ENH AREA HAS BEEN SHIFTED SWD/SEWD TO ACCOUNT FOR THE ANTICIPATED CORRIDOR OF GREATEST SVR-WIND POTENTIAL THROUGH THE EVENING/EARLY OVERNIGHT HOURS. ELSEWHERE...MRGL DELINEATION EXTENDS E/W ACROSS PARTS OF N TX/LA AND VICINITY TO ACCOUNT FOR ISOLATED SVR-WIND POTENTIAL ACCOMPANYING LINGERING CONVECTIVE POTENTIAL INVOF A DIFFUSE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY AND SUFFICIENT RESIDUAL BUOYANCY THROUGH THE NIGHT.

sections.title: PORTIONS OF CNTRL/ERN MT
sections.text: MRGL DELINEATION ADDRESSES THE POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED SVR-WIND POTENTIAL TO ACCOMPANY LOOSELY ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS SPREADING ACROSS MODESTLY DEEP/DRY SUB-CLOUD LAYERS IN ADVANCE OF A MID-LEVEL CYCLONE CENTERED NEAR THE NRN ID/SRN BRITISH COLUMBIA BORDER. THIS ACTIVITY WILL LIKELY CONTINUE THROUGH THE LATE EVENING HOURS.

sections.title: OTHER AREAS OF STRONG-TSTM POTENTIAL
sections.text: A FEW STRONG TSTMS WITH LOCALLY GUSTY WINDS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE FROM SERN VA TO CNTRL NC TO SRN SC AND ADJACENT ERN GA WITH MULTICELL CLUSTERS EVOLVING IN A HIGH-PW ENVIRONMENT FOSTERING ENHANCED PRECIP LOADING. ANTECEDENT CONVECTIVE PROCESSING AND RELATED BUOYANCY DEFICITS WILL MINIMIZE THE SVR RISK. AN ENE/WSW-ORIENTED BAND OF SCATTERED TO NUMEROUS CONVECTION FROM WV TO KY MAY ALSO PRODUCE LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS...THOUGH POOR LAPSE RATES WILL MITIGATE THE SVR RISK. ..COHEN.. 07/16/2016

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED STORM CAPABLE OF HAIL AND WIND MAY PERSIST THIS MORNING ACROSS N TX.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A CONVECTIVELY INDUCED LOW OR MCV APPEARS TO BE ENHANCING THUNDERSTORMS OVER N TX THIS MORNING WITH EVIDENCE OF HAIL AND WIND. THE 12Z SOUNDING FROM FWD SHOWED GOOD LAPSE RATES ALOFT AND INSTABILITY BUT A DISTINCT LACK OF SHEAR. THE WRN CELL MAY PERSIST FOR 1-2 HRS AS IT TURNS SEWD TOWARD THE FT. WORTH AREA LATER THIS MORNING. DUE TO THE ISOLATED NATURE OF THE THREAT...A WATCH IS NOT EXPECTED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED/SPORADIC WIND DAMAGE POSSIBLE NEAR STRONGER THUNDERSTORMS THIS AFTERNOON. A WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED FOR THIS ACTIVITY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SATELLITE/RADAR AND LIGHTNING INDICATES INCREASING THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY ACROSS CENTRAL SOUTH CAROLINA AND ADJACENT SOUTHERN NORTH CAROLINA WITHIN THE PAST HOUR. THESE STORMS ARE IN A VERY MARGINALLY SHEARED ENVIRONMENT...BUT MODERATE TO STRONG DESTABILIZATION WILL SUPPORT OUTFLOW-DOMINANT STORMS CAPABLE OF STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS AND TREE DAMAGE. GIVEN THE OUTFLOW-DOMINANT NATURE OF THIS ACTIVITY...THERE IS A LOW CHANCE THAT STORM MAY ORGANIZE/CONGEAL INTO A SMALL MCS...WHICH MAY LOCALLY ENHANCE THE SEVERE THREAT IN THE DISCUSSION AREA. ON THE WHOLE...THE RANDOM/SPORADIC NATURE OF THE THREAT SUGGESTS THAT A WW WILL NOT BE NEEDED FOR THIS ACTIVITY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A CLUSTER OF SEVERE STORMS WILL FORM OVER EASTERN COLORADO AND SPREAD SOUTH-SOUTHEAST OVER WESTERN KS INTO THIS EVENING. VERY LARGE HAIL AND A BRIEF TORNADO WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH INITIAL STORMS...LIKELY TRANSITIONING TO MAINLY A SEVERE WIND RISK /POSSIBLY SIGNIFICANT/.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 18Z SURFACE ANALYSIS PLACED A CYCLONE BETWEEN KLIC AND KITR WITH A COMPOSITE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY/FRONT ARCING EAST-SOUTHEAST THROUGH NORTHWEST/NORTH-CENTRAL KS...AND A TROUGH WEST-SOUTHWEST ACROSS THE PALMER DIVIDE. CBS HAVE INITIALLY FORMED ALONG THE TROUGH WITH CU CLUMPING FARTHER EAST ACROSS WESTERN KS TO THE SOUTH OF THE FRONT. PERSISTENT CONVERGENCE ALONG THESE BOUNDARIES SHOULD RESULT IN SCATTERED STORMS FORMING IN THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS. A VEERING WIND PROFILE WITH HEIGHT AMID STEEP LAPSE RATES WILL SUPPORT UPDRAFT ROTATION AND RISKS FOR VERY LARGE HAIL AND A BRIEF TORNADO. THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD GROW UPSCALE INTO A SOUTH-SOUTHEASTWARD MOVING MCS OVER MAINLY WESTERN KS DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON AND EVENING. PRESENCE OF LARGE BUOYANCY /CURRENTLY CENTERED ON SOUTHWEST KS/ WILL SUPPORT A RISK FOR INTENSE WIND GUSTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE WIND GUSTS ARE POSSIBLE IN PORTIONS OF THE DISCUSSION AREA THIS AFTERNOON AND EARLY EVENING. A WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED FOR THIS ACTIVITY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED TO SCATTERED CONVECTION HAS INCREASED GRADUALLY ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA OVER THE PAST HOUR OR TWO. THESE STORMS ARE IN AN ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY /AROUND 3000 J/KG MUCAPE/ AND WEAK WESTERLY DEEP SHEAR. STORM ORGANIZATION IS EXPECTED TO BE MOSTLY MARGINAL...ALTHOUGH IT IS NOT OUT OF THE QUESTION THAT A BROKEN LINE MAY FORM ALONG A WEAK COLD FRONT IN NORTHERN PORTIONS OF THE DISCUSSION AREA. ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS ARE POSSIBLE AS STORMS PROPAGATE SLOWLY THROUGH THE DISCUSSION AREA DURING THE AFTERNOON AND EARLY EVENING. A WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED FOR THIS ACTIVITY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE WIND/HAIL MAY ACCOMPANY HIGH-BASED STORMS DEVELOPING OVER NORTHEAST NM AND LIKELY SPREADING INTO PARTS OF THE TX PANHANDLE THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SCATTERED STORMS ARE ONGOING FROM THE RATON MESA TO THE LEE OF THE SANGRE DE CRISTO MOUNTAINS. SURFACE TEMPERATURE/DEW POINT SPREADS ARE AROUND 30-50 DEG F DOWNSTREAM OF THIS ACTIVITY. WITH GENERALLY LIGHT SOUTHERLY LOW-LEVEL WINDS PER FDX/AMA VWP DATA AND PROBABLE MODEST MID/UPPER-LEVEL NORTHWESTERLIES...THE STRENGTH OF DEEP SHEAR SHOULD TEND TO FOSTER WEAKLY ORGANIZED CLUSTERING AS STORMS SPREAD SOUTHEAST. OVERALL SETUP MAY SUPPORT MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL NEXT FEW HOURS...WITH ISOLATED SEVERE WIND GUSTS AS THE PRIMARY THREAT. WW POTENTIAL MAY INCREASE LATER IN THE EVENING IF A CONSOLIDATED COLD POOL CAN FORM AMID A STRENGTHENING LLJ.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS WILL CONTINUE DEVELOPING OVER WRN MT SPREADING INTO NCNTRL MT DURING THE EVENING. HIGH BASED SUPERCELLS WITH A THREAT FOR A FEW INSTANCES OF LARGE HAIL AND DOWNBURST WINDS ARE THE MAIN THREATS. WW ISSUANCE WILL PROBABLY NOT BE NECESSARY DUE TO THE ANTICIPATED SPARSE COVERAGE OF SEVERE EVENTS...BUT TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: DEEPER FORCING FOR ASCENT IN ASSOCIATION WITH A SLOW MOVING SHORTWAVE TROUGH LOCATED OVER NRN ID/NWRN MT IS SUPPORTING THUNDERSTORMS OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF WRN MT. THE DOWNSTREAM ATMOSPHERE IS CHARACTERIZED BY MID 40S TO 50F SFC DEWPOINTS...TEMPERATURES NEAR 80F...A WEAK CAP AND MLCAPE FROM 500-1000 J/KG. ELY LOW-LEVEL WINDS BENEATH A BELT OF 40 KT WINDS ALOFT WITHIN BASE OF THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH IS CONTRIBUTING TO 40-45 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR...SUFFICIENT FOR A FEW HIGH BASED SUPERCELLS. ACTIVITY WILL CONTINUE DEVELOPING THROUGH THE MODESTLY UNSTABLE WARM SECTOR OVER THE HIGH PLAINS OF NCNTRL MT POSING A THREAT FOR A FEW INSTANCES OF LARGE HAIL AND DOWNBURST WINDS THROUGH THE EARLY EVENING HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE FOR SEVERAL MORE HOURS ACROSS SWRN KS AND SHOULD AFFECT THE NERN TX PANHANDLE AND NWRN OK WITHIN A FEW HOURS. LARGE HAIL...WIND DAMAGE AND A BRIEF TORNADO WILL BE POSSIBLE. WW ISSUANCE MAY BECOME NECESSARY DOWNSTREAM OF WW 388.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS 1008 MB MESOLOW OVER SERN CO WITH UPSLOPE ELY FLOW LOCATED TO THE EAST AND NORTH OF THE LOW ACROSS PARTS OF ERN CO AND KS EXTENDING SEWD INTO WRN OK. SFC DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE UPPER 60S F IN THE GARDEN CITY AREA JUST AHEAD OF A CLUSTER OF STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS. FURTHER TO THE SOUTH...SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE TX PANHANDLE ARE IN THE MID TO UPPER 50S F BUT LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE INCREASES WITH EWD EXTENT ACROSS WRN AND NRN OK. THIS MAY FAVOR A MORE SEWD MOVEMENT WITH THE CLUSTER OF STORMS AS IT MOVES ALONG AN AXIS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY WHERE LOW TO MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE QUITE STEEP. THIS COMBINED WITH 35 TO 40 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR EVIDENT ON THE DODGE CITY WSR-88D VWP WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL. HAILSTONES OF GREATER THAN 2 INCHES IN DIAMETER MAY OCCUR WITH THE MOST DOMINANT STORMS WITHIN THE CLUSTER. A WIND DAMAGE THREAT WILL ALSO BE LIKELY WITH THE STRONGER DOWNDRAFTS ESPECIALLY WITH CELL MERGERS AND BOWING LINE SEGMENTS. A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO CAN NOT BE RULED OUT. WW ISSUANCE MAY BECOME NECESSARY ACROSS THE OK PANHANDLE EXTENDING SEWD ACROSS THE NERN TX PANHANDLE INTO WRN OK EARLY THIS EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT WILL CONTINUE ACROSS PARTS OF THE TX PANHANDLE AND WRN OK EVENTUALLY SPREADING SEWD INTO NW TX AND SCNTRL OK. WIND DAMAGE AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A WELL-DEVELOPED LINE OF STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS IS ONGOING FROM JUST SOUTHEAST OF AMARILLO TX NEWD TO JUST WEST OF WICHITA KS. THIS LINE OF STORMS IS LOCATED ON THE NWRN EDGE OF MODERATE INSTABILITY WHERE SFC DEWPOINTS ARE GENERALLY IN THE UPPER 60S TO NEAR 70 F AND MLCAPE VALUES ARE ESTIMATED IN THE 2000 TO 3500 J/KG RANGE. THE STRONGEST INSTABILITY IS ANALYZED ACROSS THE LOW ROLLING PLAINS AND ALONG THE RED RIVER IN NORTH TX AND SRN OK. THE ENVIRONMENT ALONG THIS CORRIDOR WILL BE THE MOST FAVORABLE FOR SEVERE STORMS OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. SHORT TERM MODELS INCLUDING THE ESRL HRRR MOVE THE COLD POOL INTO WRN OK AND ACROSS NW TX THROUGH THIS LATE EVENING WHERE ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND WIND DAMAGE WILL BE POSSIBLE. ALTHOUGH NEW WW ISSUANCE CAN NOT BE RULED OUT DOWNSTREAM OF WW 388...THE ESRL HRRR WEAKENS THE LINE AROUND 06Z SUGGESTING THAT THE SEVERE THREAT MAY BE CONTAINED BY THE CURRENT SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH. NEW WW ISSUANCE TO THE SOUTHEAST OF WW 388 APPEARS UNLIKELY ATTM BUT STILL CANNOT BE TOTALLY RULED OUT. ..BROYLES.. 07/16/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A WIND DAMAGE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE FOR A COUPLE MORE HOURS ACROSS NW TX AD SW OK POSSIBLY REACHING PARTS OF NCNTRL TX AND SCNTRL OK AFTER MIDNIGHT. HOWEVER...THE THREAT SHOULD BECOME MORE ISOLATED AND MARGINAL WITH TIME AND WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED TO THE SOUTHEAST OF WW 389. A LOCAL EXTENSION IN AREA AND TIME COULD BE NEEDED ALONG THE STRONGEST SEGMENT OF THE LINE AS IT APPROACHES THE SERN EDGE OF THE WATCH AFTER MIDNIGHT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR ANALYSIS SHOWS A LINEAR MCS OVER THE SRN TX PANHANDLE EXTENDING NEWD INTO WRN OK. THE MCS IS LOCATED ALONG THE NWRN EDGE OF MODERATE INSTABILITY WHICH EXTENDS FROM THE SERN PART OF WW 389 SEWD TO NEAR THE RED RIVER AND INTO NCNTRL TX. MLCAPE VALUES ALONG THIS CORRIDOR ARE ESTIMATED FROM 2000 TO 3000 J/KG WITH 700-500 MB LAPSE RATES IN THE 7.0 TO 7.5 C/KM RANGE. THIS ALONG WITH MODERATE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR SHOULD SUPPORT STORM ROTATION AND POSSIBLY HAIL WITH CELLS EMBEDDED IN THE MORE INTENSE PORTION OF THE LINE. IN ADDITION...A SEWD MOVEMENT OF THE LINE AT NEAR 35 KT ALONG WITH INCREASING LOW-LEVEL FLOW OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO SHOULD HELP TO MAINTAIN A WIND DAMAGE THREAT. IN SPITE OF THIS...SHORT-TERM MODEL FORECASTS INCLUDING THE ESRL HRRR SUGGEST THAT THE LINE WILL GRADUALLY BECOME DISORGANIZED INTO THE EARLY MORNING HOURS. ALTHOUGH WW ISSUANCE CAN NOT BE RULED OUT TO THE SOUTHEAST OF WW 389...THE LINE IS EXPECTED TO WEAKEN AFTER 06Z WITH THE SEVERE THREAT BECOMING ISOLATED AND MARGINAL. ..BROYLES.. 07/16/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
